messages:
ivan_support: Escalation from SUP-4987: Onboarding blocked for Meridian Labs. Users in their QA group intermittently get a 403 when reaching the redirect after SSO. Customer is mid-onboarding and renewal/discussion in ~25 days. Need CS + AE notified and a comms plan. Error: '403 ExchangeTokenFailed' in the auth proxy.

ivan_support: Repro steps in ticket: SP-initiated login -> SAML success -> token exchange call to /auth/exchange returns 403 for some users. Happened first at 2024-07-05T14:02:10Z and recurred ~every 5-10 min for ~2 hours. Logs attached.

zoe_cs: Thanks Ivan. I'm taking this. Can AE confirm whether this affects admin vs regular users differently? Also timeline for a fix?

evan_ae: They said it was mainly their QA/admin cohort (5 users) — blocks setup wizard. They're sensitive given the upcoming renewal. I'll join triage and message the exec sponsor.

priya_se: I can do a remote session with them now to capture headers and reproduce. Also suggest a short troubleshooting checklist: clear cookies, try incognito, check clock skew, retry. Those have been helpful previously.

tim_infra: Looking at metrics: small spike in 403s from our auth-proxy cluster around 14:00 UTC. No infra deploys at that time. I see increased 502s to token-service earlier. I'm going to enable additional debug logging for the tenant and open a mitigation flag to bypass a cache layer for token exchange.

incident_bot: [note] Mitigation-bypass enabled for tenant=meridian-labs by tim_infra at 2024-07-05T14:25:03Z

ivan_support: Customer confirmed one user could login after clearing cookies; others still failing. Ticket updated.

zoe_cs: Draft comms plan: immediate update to customer within 1 hour confirming we have an active mitigation and will run a guided session. Offer: 30m repro + enablement call today. Follow-up: RCA and timeline for permanent fix within 48 hours. Evan: can you reassure the customer about renewal touchpoint?

evan_ae: I'll send a brief note after our triage call, emphasizing we resolved the blocker for onboarding and that a technical RCA will follow. If they push on terms, I'll loop sales lead.

priya_se: On the customer call I captured token-service response body for failed exchange: '{"error":"invalid_client","detail":"client revoked"}' for some users. That suggests the client_id mapping may be inconsistent for certain assertions. Sending snippet to SUP-4987.

tim_infra: Thanks. I'll open JIRA for token-service mapping bug and link SUP-4987. For mitigation, bypass cache is stable so far. Monitoring still looks within normal error bounds after toggle.

zoe_cs: Action items:
- zoe_cs: send 1-hour status update + meeting invite
- tim_infra: track JIRA and schedule patch (owner assigned)
- priya_se: run 30m repro session and document exact repro/playbook
- evan_ae: send renewal reassurance note to sponsor; escalate to sales if needed
- ivan_support: keep SUP-4987 updated with logs/screenshots

ivan_support: I'll post the final confirmation once patch is scheduled. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
